newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera eases on negative court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera eases on negative court ruling.

text.p: Shares in Spanish tobacco group Tabacalera bucked the market trend on Monday and fell after a legal decision blocked its attempts to open the market.
According to financial daily "Cinco Dias", a court let stand a ruling under which Tabacalera could not offer incentives to tobacco stands to sell its products while it was the dominant supplier.
Tabacalera told Reuters it had no comment on the ruling, which has just been made public.
Shares in the group fell 80 pesetas, or one percent, to 7,940, while the Ibex-35 index was up 29.90 points, or 0.43 percent, to 6,939.39.
"It seems that the market didn't like this piece of news very much although it's not a surprise for us," said an analyst at a foreign bank in Madrid.
Tabacalera had requested that the ban be scrapped.
The court also required Tabacalera to ensure that competitors' products were also available.
"It's impossible to evaluate the impact of this judgment on Tabacalera's business and although the market took it badly I wouldn't give it too much importance," another analyst said.
